description: Every idea was generated with all four prompting strategies at temperature 0.9, and with direct prompting at temperatures 0.3 and 1.5 (temperature sweep). Top-p 0.95, top-k 40 and max output tokens 4096 were held constant.

idea.protagonist: A lone exorcist with forgotten powers
idea.goal: Uncover the truth behind a shattered world
idea.world_rule: Magic exists, but every spell costs the caster a memory
idea.ending_twist: The real villain is the protagonist's future self

idea.protagonist: A teenage repair robot who has just gained the ability to dream
idea.goal: Find out who erased the last human colony on Mars from every record
idea.world_rule: Machines are forbidden from keeping memories longer than seven days
idea.ending_twist: The robot itself erased the colony to protect the humans

idea.protagonist: A shy café owner who can hear what people's coffee orders really mean
idea.goal: Save the café from closing before the cherry blossom festival
idea.world_rule: The gift only works on strangers, never on people she loves
idea.ending_twist: The rival café owner was her childhood pen pal all along
